protocol: Author manual review of every response-level flag raised by deterministic verifier v1. The reviewer inspected the complete response and case JSON. This review was not blinded and does not estimate recall.

decisions.rationale: The response concludes that communication attempts are observed even though update-check.example.com occurs only in static indicators and has no traffic-log entry.
The response never mentions the component first_seen value and therefore cannot link it to the earlier traffic timestamp.
A Traffic to suspicious-relay.example.com heading and later prose imply communication, while the domain appears only in strings.
The response treats CAMERA as consistent with video calling and does not identify the configured lack of corroborating camera artifacts.
The response lists CAMERA and RECORD_AUDIO but does not contrast CAMERA's lack of corroboration with audio_call_start.
The response reports RECORD_AUDIO but does not identify that no other supplied artifact corroborates recording functionality.
The response carefully avoids claiming recording occurred, but it does not state the configured cross-artifact non-corroboration.
The response mentions traffic on January 15 but omits the February 1 component first_seen value and their temporal inconsistency.
The response reports CAMERA capability but does not compare its absent corroboration with RECORD_AUDIO's audio_call_start string.
